5433870.name: Ghosts Before Dawn
5433870.shortDescription: Survive a night of Chinese folklore in Ghosts Before Dawn, a pixel-art survivor-like. Wield auto-casting talismans, flying swords, and spirit-banishing gongs. Combine weapons and the Five Elements, brave haunted villages and ghost markets, then face the final bosses after ten minutes of survival.
about: Keep the night watch

The lanterns are still burning, but the village stands empty. A corpse herder's bell rings beyond the gates. The ghost market is open for business. Beyond the snow, a brazier marks the way to shelter.

Ghosts Before Dawn is a pixel-art survivor-like inspired by Chinese folklore. Your weapons cast automatically while you weave through enemies, gather experience, and choose the upgrades that will carry you through the night. Survive ten minutes, then defeat the final bosses to reach daybreak.
Build your own ghost-banishing arsenal

Combine homing talismans, orbiting swords, summoned paper corpses, and spirit-banishing gongs. Build with 13 weapons, 17 evolved forms, and 14 passive items. Start with five weapon slots and five passive slots, unlock a sixth of each through permanent upgrades, discover four weapon synergies, and choose between alternate evolutions for four weapons.
Bring the Five Elements together

Chain attacks through the generating cycle of Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water to trigger area bursts. Equip all five elements to strengthen your build and unleash a recurring formation around you.
Find a way through seven haunted locations
Hold a protective formation in a corpse hall. Take shelter aboard a lantern-lit ferry. Spend your hard-earned coins at the ghost market and warm yourself beside a brazier during a blizzard.
Return stronger for the next night

Unlock 8 characters, each with a starting weapon and a distinct trait. Invest in 21 permanent upgrades, pursue 30 in-game achievements, fill your collection, and test new builds across five difficulty levels.
Keep moving. Dawn is not here yet.
Join our community

5471990.name: Disk Defragmenter
5471990.shortDescription: You watched the defragmenter as a kid. Now it's your turn. Sweep the read head across scrambled disks, hear fragments click into place, and upgrade your machine from a 1998 floppy to a 2032 archive array, recovering thirty years of one ordinary life along the way.
about: Disk Defragmenter is a nostalgic incremental game inspired by Windows 98. Move your mouse to put scattered fragments back in place and turn messy disks into neat bands of color. Earn bytes and upgrade your read head, progressing from one block at a time to clearing whole patches in a single sweep.
Sort, upgrade, and speed up

Move your mouse to read fragments without holding a button. Widen your read head, read more blocks at once, or let auto-cursors help. As you progress, unlock overclocking, chain reactions, and active skills: press W to sort an entire file or Q to release a fragment shockwave.
Open the upgrade panel at any time while sorting. Both the disk and the challenge timer pause while you choose your upgrades, then resume when you close it.
Beat the clock or take your time

Timed challenges begin at the fourth computer. Finish sorting before the countdown ends to clear the disk. If you fail, the disk resets, but you keep the bytes you earned and the upgrades you bought for your next attempt.
Revisit earlier disks to earn rewards, and complete a Replay Tour for an extra bonus. Prefer a slower pace? Enable Casual mode in Settings to play through the main game without a time limit.
Ten computers, over thirty years of life
From a 1998 floppy and a college dorm laptop to your parents’ old computer and a family archive in 2032, ten computers trace one ordinary person’s life.
Recover and open 80 story files: school reports, chat logs, a wedding guest list, and more. These fragments gradually piece together a life, ending with a letter to the future.

Each computer brings different sorting challenges. Clear duplicate files, stop viruses from spreading, repair bad sectors, and coordinate mirrored read heads. Later disks offer more than just extra space to sort.
Keep playing after the ending

After completing the main game, reinstall the system and spend restore points on permanent BIOS boosts for a new playthrough. You can also select challenge modifiers for greater difficulty and rewards.
There are also daily challenges, commissions from six friends, and 23 in-game achievements.
Free demo

The demo includes the first five computers and 40 story files. Try the upgrade system, duplicate cleanup, virus removal, and timed challenges. Daily challenges become available after you clear the fourth computer.

5496540.name: Street Panz
5496540.shortDescription: Heavy punches, big bellies and scores to settle. Street Panz is a single-player 2D fighting game: choose from eight fighters, take on the neighborhood rivals and four bosses, sharpen your moves and climb the local leaderboard.
about: THE NEIGHBORHOOD HAS A SCORE TO SETTLE.

From the bar to the garage, from the tavern to the building site: in Street Panz, neighborhood rivalries spill into the fighting arena. Pick your character and face the CPU in one-on-one bouts with punches, kicks, throws and special moves. This is a 2D arcade fighting game full of larger-than-life locals and neighborhood humor.EIGHT WAYS TO MAKE YOUR POINT

Gigi, Rocco, Nando, Toni, Bruno, Franco, Rosa and Wanda each have their own personality, animations, throws and special moves. Read your opponent, find an opening and mix standing, low and aerial attacks. Every fight has its own rhythm, and a well-timed block can turn a round around.FIGHT YOUR WAY TO THE COMMENDATORE

Arcade mode pits you against the other seven fighters, followed by four bosses, with a personal rival along the way. Cinematic prologues, interludes and endings with subtitles follow all eight protagonists. Between bouts, the Grande Abbuffata eating challenge and the Muro del Commendatore wall challenge test your timing and add points to your run.
Resume your progress from checkpoints, improve your score and put your three initials on the local top 10 leaderboard.A QUICK BOUT, OR TIME TO PRACTICE
Choose your fighter, CPU opponent and arena for a single fight. In Training mode, practice moves and spacing with a configurable opponent before heading back into the neighborhood.WHAT'S IN THE GAME
• Eight playable fighters, four bosses on the arcade ladder and a secret encounter with Turi.
• Eight selectable arenas, plus dedicated boss locations in Arcade mode.
• Arcade, single-fight and Training modes.
• Personal stories with cinematic sequences, a story gallery and saved Arcade progress.
• Two bonus challenges and a score leaderboard saved on your PC.
• A reduced-motion presentation option and separate music and sound-effect controls.
Street Panz is a single-player experience against the CPU. Interface and subtitles are available in Italian, English, French, German, Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil) and Russian.

5521140.name: Void Walker
5521140.shortDescription: Void Walker is an endless 2D pixel-art platformer set in a dark abyss. Use simple controls and precise timing to dodge deadly obstacles, collect glowing orbs, and beat your highest score.
about: Survive the abyss. Void Walker is a timing and reflex-based endless 2D pixel-art platformer. Your primary goal is to dodge obstacles, collect glowing orbs, and reach the highest score possible.

Gameplay Mechanics The game is easy to learn but hard to master. It features simple controls focused entirely on making the right move at the right time. The margin for error is low; you must improve your reflexes to beat your own high score with every run.
Key Features
• Endless Progression: A continuous platforming experience in a mysterious void atmosphere that progressively gets harder.
• Pixel Art: A dark, shadowy dimension designed with classic 2D graphics.
• Score-Driven Loop: A competitive scoring system directly tied to the orbs you collect and the obstacles you overcome.
• Minimalist Controls: Highly responsive mechanics that players of all skill levels can easily pick up.
